Transform callers run after exportFunction initialization. The emission caller substituteBinaryExpression enters only for getExports names: bindings/specifiers require present moduleInfo, or the resolver proves a same-file SourceFile export container. That file is transformed, and all three caches were populated together under its original id before onEmitNode restores exportFunction. Binder declareSourceFileMember gives ordinary script identifier declarations no parent; qualified CommonJS exports do not pass the identifier-assignment guard. A SourceFile export parent for the qualifying identifier is therefore an external module, and JSON has no such identifier assignment.
